text:
eva: heads up — calibration plots for quant-ggml-int8 on qa-dev look wrong, ECE jumped from 0.032 -> 0.18 after the quantized bring-up.
raj: ugh. CI alert? link: https://ci.redwood/alerts/2345
ml-ci-bot: [alert] eval-runner/qa-dev calibration ECE regression detected (+0.148) — see artifacts.
josh: can you paste the calibration script? last time we had weird behavior when sample_weights were applied incorrectly.
carmen: I pulled artifacts. The runner is doing binning like this:
```
probs = preds[:, 1]
bins = np.linspace(0,1,11)
inds = np.digitize(probs, bins) - 1
bin_acc = np.zeros(len(bins)-1)
for i in range(len(bin_acc)):
    bin_acc[i] = np.mean(labels[inds==i])
```
but for weighted evals we expected to use sample_weights. I see another helper doing `np.histogram(..., weights=weights)` elsewhere, but not here.
josh: looks like a mix — when we shard and recombine metrics we collapse per-shard counts and then re-normalize by total samples, but the bin edges are computed per-shard. That can move samples between bins on recombine.
raj: oh nice catch. So two issues: 1) no support for sample_weights in bin acc calculation, 2) inconsistent global binning across shards.
eva: repro steps I used:
- run eval-runner locally with --shards=4 --quantized
- compare ece calculation in runner vs. naive global calculation
```
# naive global
probs = all_preds[:,1]
weights = all_weights
ece = np.sum(np.abs(bin_acc - bin_conf) * bin_wts)
```
I can attach a notebook.
carmen: also saw Brier score being computed as `np.mean((preds - labels)**2)` but preds are class logits before softmax on some codepaths for quant model. So Brier is meaningless there.
raj: wow. So root causes: logits vs probs, missing sample_weights, inconsistent binning across shards. No wonder calibration exploded.
josh: quick fix: (a) ensure runner finalizes by recomputing global bins using global probs (collect bin edges once from aggregated probs) or use fixed bin edges at eval config time, (b) pass sample_weights into bin averages, (c) ensure Brier uses softmax probs. I can draft PR.
eva: can we also add a unit test that serializes shards -> recombines and asserts ECE stable within 1e-6? would catch this.
carmen: +1. I'll open an incident and assign to eng-ml for hotfix. @josh can you include a small synthetic test in runner/tests/test_calibration.py?
josh: yup, will do. Drafting PR: https://git.redwood/pull/4567 — includes fix + tests + a note about quant codepaths emitting probs.
ml-ci-bot: PR 4567 checks started — will run eval CI.
raj: thanks y'all. After PR merges we should re-run the qa-dev baselines and update the model bring-up notes.
eva: assigning follow-up: verify dashboard curves for historical runs (cc: @carmen) :thumbsup:
